entries.heading: Funds appropriated in this
ancestors: DIVISION B—EMERGENCY APPROPRIATIONS FOR CORONAVIRUS HEALTH RESPONSE AND AGENCY OPERATIONS
entries.text:
Sec. 14001.  Funds appropriated in this 
title may be made available to restore amounts, either directly or 
through reimbursement, for obligations incurred to prevent, prepare for, 
and respond to coronavirus prior to the date of enactment of this Act.

[[Page 134 STAT. 526]]
